title: Buy the White Curtain and Not the Grey Curtain
text: Buy the White Curtain and Not the Grey Curtain. I bought both the grey curtain first. It's darker than the pictures depict. Plus, the description says it lightens up the bathroom. It doesn't. It's too dark to do that. If you want a clearer view looking outside while you are inside the shower, buy the grey curtain.  If you want to lighten up your bathroom, and if you want the more attractive of the two, buy the white curtain. The white curtain is very nice. Of course, it is sheer, so if you are concerned with water getting on your bathroom floor, you'll need a liner.

product_metadata.title: Stratford Park Payton Pom Pom Sheer Buttonhole Shower Curtain White, 72 x 72
features: This gorgeous shower curtain measures 72" side-to-side x 72" top-to-bottom.
description: The solid white color is classic and fashionable, showing a sophisticated modern touch. This gorgeous shower curtain measures 72" side-to-side x 72" top-to-bottom. It's woven fabric construction with pom-poms give your shower a very light and elegant look. Perfectly sized for most bathtubs and shower stalls, this shower curtain drapes beautifully for a clean, fresh look in your bathroom.
